register.notes: No separate packaging register yet — Elektroregistrs covers WEEE/batteries only. The PPWR-mandated producer register is to be created by 12.02.2027 (KEM: registers within 24 months). Packaging compliance runs through the DRN system + contracts with licensed waste managers.

extraTaxes.name: Dabas resursu nodoklis (DRN)
extraTaxes.summary: Natural resources tax on packaging placed on the Latvian market (Dabas resursu nodokļa likums, fetched from likumi.lv 2026-08-16; version in force 15.07.2026). Packaging material rates are in Annex 7 (7. pielikums), applied per material weight unit; laminated/composite packaging is taxed by its predominant material. A contract with a licensed recovery scheme (e.g. LZP, Zaļā josta) exempts from paying DRN at the full statutory rate — that exemption is why scheme membership is the standard route. Confirmed statutory rates from the law body: plastic shopping bags & plastic-containing fishing gear €4.80/kg, wet wipes & balloons €12.20/kg, tobacco filters €8.00/kg. Per VID, from 2026 foam polystyrene packaging €44.00/kg and foam plastic €24.40/kg (up from base plastic €1.22/kg, polystyrene €2.20/kg). Full Annex 7 per-material table (glass, paper, metal, wood base rates) not machine-readable from likumi.lv this session — Annex 7 is served as a separate attachment.
extraTaxes.rate: packaging by material (Annex 7); e.g. plastic bags/fishing gear €4.80/kg, foam polystyrene €44.00/kg (2026)

thresholds.deMinimis: 0 kg — DRN liability starts with the first packaging placed on the market
